justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/modifier/FieldManifestation.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/modifier/FieldManifestationTest.java`. The target is a small enum with only 3 constants (`PLAIN`, `FINAL`, `VOLATILE`), 1 field, 1 constructor, and 4 simple query methods (`getMask`, `getRange`, `isDefault`, `isFinal`, `isVolatile`, `isPlain`); it is a focused modifier value type rather than a class with multiple responsibilities or excessive size.
